response.sql: WITH ev AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_rem, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / b.amount) AS avg_over FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), st AS (SELECT status, AVG(avg_rem) AS avg_remaining, AVG(avg_over) AS avg_overspend_rate FROM ev GROUP BY status) SELECT status, avg_remaining, avg_overspend_rate, avg_remaining / (SELECT AVG(avg_remaining) FROM st) AS remaining_ratio FROM st
